text:
**Authorization cannot be determined from the available evidence.** The tools report 0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2023, but they do not include permits or other authorization records.

The 2021 national forest map classified 0.4 hectares of the loss area as planted eucalyptus and 0.3 hectares as outside mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest. That classification alone does not establish whether the removal was authorized. Relevant permits or records from the responsible authority would be needed.
